meaning.zh:
“去炸个蛋吧”，意指 “别烦我” 或 “去忙你自己的事”。

这个短语在英语中是一个较为生动的表达，类似于中文中的 “走开点” 或 “去一边待着”。它最早出现在20世纪初，可能是作为一种幽默或讽刺的方式来劝阻某人停止烦扰。例如，当别人一直打扰你时，你可能会用它来表达让对方不要继续干扰自己。
meaning.en: This phrase is a lively expression in English similar to telling someone to "get lost" or "mind their own business." It emerged in the early 20th century, likely as a humorous or sarcastic method to get someone to stop bothering you. For example, when someone keeps pestering you, you might use it to tell them to back off.

lines.en: He kept asking me questions, so finally, I told him to go fry an egg.
lines.zh: 他一直问我问题，所以最后我让他去炸个蛋。

lines.en: If you're not going to help, just go fry an egg!
lines.zh: 如果你不打算帮忙，就去炸个蛋吧！

lines.en: When he started complaining again, she told him to go fry an egg and stop whining.
lines.zh: 当他再次开始抱怨时，她让他去炸个蛋，别再发牢骚了。
